certificate.description: Qualcomm® Inline Crypto Engine (UFS) provides high throughput storage data encryption and decryption. Inline Crypto Engine (UFS) versions 3.2.0 [1], 3.2.1 [2], 4.0.1 [3] and 4.0.2 [4] are supported by various Qualcomm platforms including Qualcomm QCM6490 [1], Qualcomm QCM4490 [2], Qualcomm QCS6490 [1], Qualcomm QCS4490 [2], Snapdragon® 695 5G Mobile Platform [1], Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 Mobile Platform [3], Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 Mobile Platform [2], Snapdragon 4 Gen 2 Mobile Platform [2], Snapdragon 6 Gen 1 Mobile Platform [2], Snapdragon 7 Gen 1 Mobile Platform [2], Snapdragon 8 Gen 1 Mobile Platform [2], and Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 Mobile Platform [4].
